messages:
michelle: Heads-up — onboarding sample app (nextjs + edge worker) breaks for people using the hosted SDK after the latest dual-pkg change. Error in Cloudflare workers: \"TypeError: require is not defined\" when loading our cjs entry from a conditional export.

jamal: ugh. is that the package.json 'exports' shape we landed yesterday?

kevin_s: yep. we added conditional exports so node import resolves to ./dist/esm/index.mjs and require resolves to ./dist/cjs/index.cjs. Cloudflare picks the wrong branch -> tries to require in an ESM-only env.

sophia: also seeing TS users complain that their IDE can't find typings for the edge build. tsserver falls back to the root types, but our .d.ts only lives under dist/cjs currently.

michelle: repro steps I gave to support: clone sample-app, npm i, node ./scripts/run-edge-local.sh -> fails. Repro in Playwright CI too.

jamal: can we add an explicit "edge" export target? like: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./edge": {
    "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "types": "./dist/edge/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```
That way workers can import 'redwood@edge' or we can rewrite sample to import './edge'.

kevin_s: honest question — do we want a separate import target for workers, or should we try to make the default import work in both Node ESM & edge runtimes? The latter is tricky because some runtimes treat conditional exports differently.

sophia: types-first thought: TS resolves types via package.json "types" or via exports.types. If we add a top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" it helps editors. But that doesn't solve runtime require/import mismatch.

michelle: another pain point: auth+retry behaves differently between cjs and esm builds. In cjs we patch global fetch for retries (legacy), in esm we export a wrapper. So sample app using copy-paste from README gets the older behavior depending on which entrypoint resolved. People hit intermittent 401s when the retry wrapper isn't applied.

jamal: that's bad. We need parity: same exported API semantics regardless of entrypoint. Either ensure both bundles include the same runtime adapter or move adapter into a tiny universal module (UMD-ish) that both entrypoints import.

kevin_s: small patch proposal: create dist/universal/adapter.js which does feature-detect (globalThis.fetch && typeof globalThis.fetch === 'function') and applies the retry shim idempotently. Then both esm/cjs/edge bundles import it as the first side-effect. Keeps runtime behaviour consistent.

sophia: +1 for universal adapter. Also we should update README sample to import from 'redwood/edge' if they target workers. That avoids surprises while we converge on conditional exports behavior across runtimes.

michelle: timeline ask from support: can we ship a quick fix for the sample app CI failing? I can push a patch to the sample app to explicitly import './edge' and add a note. Then follow up with changes in the SDK package next week.

jamal: SGTM. For the longer term let's open a tiny RFC: publish strategy for edge compat. Items: exports shape (edge alias vs single export), where types live (top-level types vs exports.types), and runtime parity (universal adapter).

dev-bot: ci/samples — sample-app-edge-test failed on run 3: exit code 1 (see logs)

kevin_s: I'll send a PR with the universal adapter + top-level types and CI test that runs the sample in a CF worker emulator. If we greenlight that, we can deprecate the older require-only adapters.

michelle: thanks — also add a short blurb in migration notes: \"If you rely on require() semantics, pin to vX.Y.Z until we finish migration\". Support will need that to triage.

jamal: final thought — for DX, add a quick-check script in the sample repo that runs node compatibility checks: ESM import, CJS require, and a worker import. It outputs which entrypoint resolved; good for local debugging.

michelle: perfect. i'll update the sample and the docs. tagging @sophia for types follow-up when you're free. :thumbsup:

sophia: on it. will sketch the exports/types proposal today. :coffee:

kevin_s: thumbs up. I'll link the PR in this thread when ready.

michelle: cool — closing the loop here. thanks team.
